mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions, increasing wage pressures and corporate profit margins, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 3.0% signals a tightening monetary policy regime, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential investment (HOUST) and personal consumption (RSAFS) signals strong aggregate demand, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0, following a prior uptick, signals a manufacturing contraction that increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 100.0 and INDPRO declined > 2.0pp from peak in last 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO < 100.0 and declined > 2.0pp, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in real personal consumption (RSAFS) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and investment momentum, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both RSAFS and HOUST rise, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200k in a single month, combined with a stable unemployment rate, signals robust labor demand and rising corporate hiring, which supports earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 200.0 and UNRATE unchanged (Δ < 0.1pp) in last month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS > 200.0 and UNRATE stable, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% year-over-year, combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate, signals persistent inflationary pressures that trigger monetary tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS ≥ 2.0%, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) above 3.0% annualized, following a prior contraction, signals a strong recovery in aggregate demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 > 3.0% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
